blocking_requirement: Two actual independent blinded human primary annotation streams per item, with distinct human adjudication where triggered, followed by frozen-policy HELD_OUT replication.
missing_external_evidence: A recruited/authorized pool supplying two different actual human primary annotators for every calibration item under the accepted blinding protocol.
Stable pseudonymous annotator identities and completed schema-valid primary annotation records while preserving peer/target/evaluator/judge/arm blinding.
A distinct actual human adjudicator for every disagreement or protocol-triggered adjudication, preserving both pre-adjudication streams.
Completed source-grouped CALIBRATION records sufficient to compute agreement, confusion/error and calibration evidence without treating model labels as human gold.
A policy/evaluator freeze after calibration, followed by independent source-grouped HELD_OUT human replication with persisted results and uncertainty/error analysis.
unblock_condition: Provide access to the required independent human annotators/adjudicator and complete the accepted blinded CALIBRATION packet; then start a fresh attempt ID, compute/adjudicate calibration evidence, freeze policy, and execute separate HELD_OUT replication.
integrity_statement: No human annotations, adjudications, agreement statistics, calibration curves, or HELD_OUT outcomes were fabricated or auto-filled by an LLM/model in this attempt.
